fee_notes: Base fee is $43,000 plus $0.43 per person above 100,000 in territory. During fiscal 2025, actual collected fees ranged $5,000–$63,261 due to discounts: existing franchisee (30%), military/veterans (30%), diversity ($5,000). Additional Population Fee and discounts cannot be combined.
raw_excerpt: The base initial franchise fee is $43,000 plus $0.43 for each person above 100,000 in the franchise territory. During the fiscal year 2025, we collected Franchise Fees (including any applicable Additional Population Fees) ranging from $5,000 to $63,261.
